conviction_note: The only finding is that the H1 profit plan is almost certain to be beaten (Q1 recurring 124m yen is 56.9% of the 218m yen H1 plan, against a 5-year average of 46.4%). That progress rate is public. The company held its full-year plan at H1 last year and again at Q3, when it was already 117% of plan, so a beat without a revision is the expected outcome. Last year the same setup (H1 recurring +31% vs plan, plan held) moved the stock about +0.33% on the estimated window. The finding is sized +0.2 and the scaled number is 0.06 x 0.65 = +0.04. Both are essentially zero, and they agree in sign.
bar: The company's own H1 (Mar-Aug) plan from 2026-04-13: sales 1,852m, operating profit 200m, recurring 218m, net 173m yen (kabutan finance page https://kabutan.jp/stock/finance?code=9661). No 四季報/IFIS consensus could be sourced for this one-analyst-or-less name, so every size is capped small. Estimate: Q2 recurring of roughly 100-130m against the 94m the plan implies gives H1 of about 225-255m, which is +3% to +17% versus 218m. 8% is the central figure.
positioning_check: JPX short register: 0.0% disclosed (no position at or above 0.5%), change 0.0 pts, as of 2026-09-29 (https://www.jpx.co.jp/markets/public/short-selling/index.html). Kabutan shows the name as 貸借非対応: 制度信用 is buy-only, so there are no margin shorts and the 信用倍率 reads '-' (https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=9661, 2026-10-13). There is no option skew. Run-up is -3.65% over 20 days and +0.25% over 5. priced_lean is +0.18.

findings.finding: The H1 (Mar-Aug 2026) plan of 218m yen recurring and 200m operating profit is very likely beaten: Q1 alone delivered 124m recurring and 103m operating profit (+19% y/y). The plan therefore needs only about 94m recurring in Jun-Aug, against 135m in the same quarter last year. No 業績予想の修正 has been filed, so the beat lands as a 差異 notice at the print with the full-year plan (337m recurring) most likely held, as it was at H1 and at Q3 last year.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The same line, an H1 beat with the FY plan held, came on 2025-10-10: H1 recurring 239m vs 182m plan (+31%). The baseline's estimated-window move was +0.33%. On 2026-01-13, Q3 cumulative was already 117% of the FY plan and the plan was held; the move was -0.94%. The median absolute reaction is 0.65%.
findings.why_not_priced: Largely priced. Kabutan published the 56.9% progress rate against the 5-year average on the day of the Q1 release, so anyone can see the beat coming. What remains unpriced is only the size of the Q2 comp against last year's 国宝 film-driven kabuki surge. A stock that had priced a large beat would show a run-up; it shows -3.65% over 20 days. With PER ~208x and holders who own it for the 優待 theatre tickets rather than for earnings, the beat has little to move.
findings.independence: Same company data, read from the kabutan finance table (https://kabutan.jp/stock/finance?code=9661): H1 plan 200/218, Q1 103/124, prior-year Q2 129/135. The plan-holding habit comes from separate releases (https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=9661&b=k202510100105 and https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=9661&b=k202601130065). All of these describe one fact, not independent confirmation.

outside_window.finding: The full-year plan (337m recurring, -11% y/y) looks conservative given Q1 progress of 36.8% (last year 36.7% of a plan later beaten by 34%). The company's record is to hold the plan and beat it at year-end via a 差異 notice, so any upward re-rating of the full year resolves at the April 2027 print.

bar_hierarchy: Forecast revision: none filed beforehand and none expected at the print; the company habitually holds its plan and issues a 差異 notice instead. Returns: the 5 yen annual dividend has been flat for years and no change was found. New-year guide: not applicable (H1). Quarter vs own 進捗率: Q1 was 56.9% of the H1 plan against a 5-year average of 46.4%, and 36.8% of the FY plan against 36.7% last year, so the H1 beat is likely and already visible.
baseline_tension: Mildly positive against a slightly positive lean (+0.18) and a -3.65% 20-day run-up. The strongest positive the release could carry would be a full-year raise or a dividend or 優待 change. I looked for all three and found nothing filed, and the company's record argues against a raise at H1. The finding barely clears zero.
lessons_applied: Rule 1 (a finding resting on a public 進捗率 is held by the price) is written for negatives. I applied its logic to this positive and moved p_up from 55 to 53, so expected_move_pct went from +0.07 to +0.04. The finding's own size (+0.2) was left unchanged because it was already sized as largely priced.

Rule 2 (negatives outnumbering positives) does not apply: the only finding is positive. The strongest positive (a raise or a returns change) was searched for and not found, as recorded in baseline_tension.
